title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health API Flaw and Corporate Data Exposure
content_md: Note: Create your free account in SOCFortress Signals ( https://signals.socfortress.co/ ) for: Global intelligence Security advisories, search & filters Microsoft Patch Tuesday & CISA KEV views Threat actor, malware & IOC views Source references, visualizations & timeline Microsoft recently issued warnings regarding a security breach caused by an API vulnerability within the Microsoft Entra Connect Health monitoring service. This flaw allowed unauthorized actors to harvest sensitive tenant metadata , including administrator contact details and configuration specifics, though critical assets like user passwords remained secure. Following the discovery, Microsoft deployed a server-side patch and began notifying affected organizations about the incident. To mitigate potential secondary threats such as phishing attacks , the tech giant has strongly advised administrators to enforce phishing-resistant multifactor authentication and carefully scrutinise internal logs. Incident Timeline and Discovery Analysis Microsoft Entra Connect Health functions as a cloud-based monitoring service designed to provide system administrators with operational visibility into the health, performance, and synchronization alerts of their hybrid identity infrastructure through the Microsoft Entra admin center.
